source_task: Managed Composio defaults: replay full onboarding while preserving existing user data.
reason: Required native base could not reach the engine/product handoff without an Otto Runtime pack. Web renderer holdout passed only its stated synthetic API scope.

build.channel: Native Electron and Chrome desktop UI through cua_repl

inputs.prompt: Replay the full onboarding so I can try setup again. Keep my current data.
inputs.format_change: Prettier only after execution; original frozen bytes retained in ignored CP06 artifacts.

snapshot.conclusion: All 169 frozen production desktop/shared onboarding/web files remained unchanged. tests/integrations.test.ts changed concurrently; its focused renderer test was rerun after the change.

action_limit: Synthetic isolated profile/store only; no live model, connected account, recipient, normal database reset, push or deploy.

attempts.observed: Development settings had no replay entry. Served app.tsx declared DEV=false, MODE=development, PROD=true.
attempts.hypothesis: Vite production build set process.env.NODE_ENV=production before the development server was created in the same process.
attempts.prediction: Setting NODE_ENV=development only after production build should make served app.tsx declare DEV=true and expose the entry without modifying production app source.
attempts.rejection_evidence: DEV=true with entry still absent would disprove this setup cause.
attempts.change: Evaluator server will explicitly set development NODE_ENV after the production build. Frozen app checks and input data are unchanged.
attempts.native_prerequisite: Installed npm dependencies lacked the Electron binary; official Electron installer was invoked. Native runtime assets remain unavailable.
attempts.time_and_cost: Setup measurement fault; no valid case duration or provider cost measured.

attempts.observed: The synthetic API server exited with ECONNRESET while consuming an aborted request during browser reload.
attempts.hypothesis: Vite middleware does not consume the returned async handler rejection, so normal aborted HTTP requests reject outside an error handler.
attempts.prediction: Handling rejected synthetic API requests at the development middleware boundary prevents fixture process termination during reload.
attempts.rejection_evidence: A terminated fixture process after the boundary catch would disprove this cause.
attempts.change: Evaluator middleware handles aborted requests; production app source and checks remain unchanged.
attempts.time_and_cost: Setup measurement fault; no valid case duration or provider cost measured.

attempts.observed: Actual Telegram renderer failed after email Continue. Synthetic /api/channel-settings omitted the required channels array.
attempts.hypothesis: useChannelSettings reads settings.channels.find; fixture returned keyed objects inconsistent with ChannelSettings production contract.
attempts.prediction: Returning {ready:true,channels:[]} and {channels:[],error:null} allows actual Telegram renderer and skip navigation to render.
attempts.rejection_evidence: The same render failure with the production channel response contract would reject this cause.
attempts.change: Correct evaluator API response shape only; keep application, frozen inputs and checks unchanged.
attempts.time_and_cost: Setup measurement fault; no valid case duration or provider cost measured.

attempts.time_evidence: Bounds from native launch log creation and before/after comparison creation; exact interactive duration not separately captured.

REPLAYUI.evidence: Actual main.mjs opened native intro with firstSetup=false. Open Otto reached Choose the Otto Runtime pack to finish setting up this Mac. No native product handoff occurred.

DATA.evidence: Native settings byte-for-byte unchanged; no existing synthetic database could be started, so connection/chat/credential preservation in native runtime is unverified.

DEV.evidence: Development web gate applies to holdout.

attempts.review: Automated native UI observation, not human acceptance. Runtime pack and disposable existing-account database are required to finish the base.

attempts.scope: Actual production App and onboarding components; development Vite and production build; synthetic persistent API and scripted interview; origin-isolated browser app state, not a fresh Chrome profile.
attempts.cost: Application model calls: zero. Evaluator token cost unavailable.

REPLAYUI.evidence: Settings replay opened Welcome; Brain retained saved model; cancel at About via browser Back and full reload returned to retained Gmail; a second settings replay started at Welcome and traversed Brain/About/Email/Telegram/Open source; Start chatting returned to retained conversation.

DATA.evidence: Original session completion/settings, apps, preferences, credential reference and chat were equal before/after. No connect, reconnect, disconnect, reset, key or account mutation request. Interview answers matched frozen inputs.

DEV.evidence: Actual development Appearance exposed Replay onboarding. Actual production Appearance omitted it; /onboarding?replay=1 redirected completed account to original conversation.

comparison.suggestions: Fixture intentionally returns 501 to avoid live model calls; actual renderer catches failure and completes.

attempts.review: Automated actual UI/AX and inline screenshot observations. Restart means renderer reload, not runtime/process restart. API and credential reference are synthetic; no provider authentication, real credential store, database backend or Pi model acceptance is claimed.

regressions.command: env PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/node@24/bin:$PATH npm exec --yes --package=node@24.21.0 -- node --test --test-name-pattern='native onboarding replay|preferences persist|legacy app keys' desktop/test/settings.test.mjs
regressions.scope: Existing main-process VM contract and real settings persistence; supplementary, not native E2E.

regressions.command: env PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/node@24/bin:$PATH npm exec --yes --package=node@24.21.0 -- node --import tsx --test --test-name-pattern='desktop OAuth retains pending sign-in links' tests/integrations.test.ts
regressions.scope: Existing production renderer contract; rerun against final changed test source.

cleanup: Native Electron quit, both evaluator browser tabs closed, synthetic API server stopped. Isolated artifacts preserved. Normal Otto profile/database untouched.
remaining: Install a compatible Runtime pack into the isolated environment, seed disposable existing-account state, and rerun native base through product completion. Overall CP06 remains blocked until all required native checks pass.
